newsitem.title: USA: Florida will sue federal government over cuts.
newsitem.headline: Florida will sue federal government over cuts.

text.p: Florida will sue the federal government claiming that pending cuts in aid to legal immigrants will force the state to pay a bill which should be federal responsibilty, Lt. Governor Buddy MacKay said on Monday.
"This will be the third suit for Governor (Lawton) Chiles on this. We are basically subsidising the federal government to the tune of about one billion dollars a year," MacKay said.
MacKay said the suit probably would be filed in a U.S. district court in Miami later this week. He spoke during a break in the state oversight board meeting guiding Miami's financial recovery.
During that meeting Miami vice-mayor Tomas Regalado said an estimated 20,000 legal immigrants would lose benefits from September under the recently approved congressional reforms.
"This coming August a man-made hurricane is going to hit South Florida," Regalado said.
MacKay said Congress was the proper forum to resolve the problem and he hoped the lawsuit would spur it to act.
